scripts.env:pull:
node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const outputs=JSON.parse(execSync('aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name CampusEvacStack --output json')).Stacks[0].Outputs;const v=Object.fromEntries(outputs.map(o=>[o.OutputKey,o.OutputValue]));require('fs').writeFileSync('.env.local','NEXT_PUBLIC_EVENTS_HTTP_HOST='+v.HttpHost+'
NEXT_PUBLIC_EVENTS_REALTIME_URL='+v.RealtimeEndpoint+'
NEXT_PUBLIC_EVENTS_API_KEY='+v.ApiKey+'
');console.log('.env.local written from CampusEvacStack outputs')"
